description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - dog walk: walking the dog, the main line is the road and the dog at your feet and the side line is the walk checklist (poop bags, water, leash) plus what the dog did - confirm the going-out checklist item by item, tap STOP when the dog stops and resolve it (poop cleaned, water given, or mark the spot as a pending cleanup point by gaze direction), and pass the home gate before ending: bags dealt with, water given, every pending point cleared - ending without the gate only stops you on the spot and names the missing items, it never says you may go home. No dog-behaviour detection, no location, no step sensing: a stop is only ever reported by your own tap, and a cleanup is only ever your own attestation. Session memory only, wiped on close.
name: dog-walk
